news.title: Kochi: Crores spent on slum rehabilitation, yet P&T Colony families without homes
news.para: Residents of P&T Colony have been moved to apartments now considered unsafe, suffering from significant construction defects like cracked walls and wastewater leaks. Families consistently raise alarms with the Greater Cochin Development Authority, but progress remains stagnant. Compounding their plight are bureaucratic hold-ups in issuing vital certificates for other families, leaving many still in limbo. Despite ongoing discussions, a resolution seems distant for those impacted.

news.title: Himachal Pradesh HC flags illegal-height Barog projects, seeks 10-year state-wide land deal data
news.para: The Himachal Pradesh high court has instructed the government to furnish an in-depth report on land purchase permits. Concerns were voiced about towering multi-storey structures breaching height regulations in Barog, Solan district. The court seeks clarity on permissions issued under Section 118 of the HP Tenancy and Land Reforms Act and demands transparency on both approved and rejected applications.

news.title: Joint property owners in Bengaluru can now split A-eKhata online, get separate records
news.para: In a bid to simplify property management, the Greater Bengaluru Authority has unveiled an online service designed for joint property owners. With this service, holders of joint A-eKhatas can easily obtain distinct e-khatas, enabling them to handle their property affairs on their own. A sub-division fee based on the guidance value will be implemented. This effort seeks to streamline property transactions in Bengaluru, reducing the need for extensive manual processes.

news.title: Pune cantonment residents oppose draft building bylaws, demand uniform FSI of two
news.para: Citizens and activists in Pune are voicing their dissent regarding the draft building bylaws that received approval from the DGDE. The latest proposals suggest a four-tier classification for permissible floor space index, deviating from a uniform FSI of 2. Activists are pushing for clarity on the standards used to set FSI limits in residential neighborhoods, particularly as many property owners encounter challenges due to vague construction restrictions.

news.title: Delhi civic body's survey identifies over 21,000 properties operating commercially in residential zones
news.para: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has identified over 21,000 properties engaged in commercial activities within residential areas. Actions against violations of land-use norms have been initiated following a Supreme Court order. Approximately 12,000 properties have paid conversion charges, while 9,000 remain non-compliant. Sealing actions have begun in specific zones, including Central and Rohini. The survey will continue in unauthorized colonies and areas benefiting from the PM-UDAY scheme.

news.title: India Cements' profit multifold to ₹38.82 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: India Cements Ltd, part of the UltraTech Cement group, has reported a remarkable surge in its net profit for the September quarter, soaring to Rs 38.82 crore from Rs 8.81 crore the previous year. Revenue from operations increased to Rs 1,142.03 crore, while domestic sales volume grew by 16.2 percent, reaching 2.83 million tonnes. Furthermore, the board has greenlit the relocation of the registered office from Tamil Nadu to Maharashtra.

news.title: DHBVN directs ATS Triumph's developer to separate power, upkeep charges
news.para: Dakshin Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam has ordered ATS Triumph to create a unified billing format for residents. This directive comes after the Haryana Electricity Regulatory Commission identified issues with billing methods and infrastructure. The developer is expected to delineate maintenance and diesel generator fees in bills to safeguard against disconnections. Compliance deadlines have been established to foster transparency and address customer concerns more efficiently.

news.title: Building around heritage, not over it: A new approach to urban development in India’s historic cities
news.para: Historic cities stand at a crossroads where preservation meets modern progress, requiring thoughtful integration of contemporary architecture alongside traditional landscapes. Ensuring sustainability and honoring local customs can significantly improve urban life. Developers are encouraged to assess how new structures will affect neighboring communities and shared spaces, fostering an environment where a robust economy flourishes in harmony with cultural heritage.

news.title: Protected tenancy in Telangana: Why due diligence must go beyond sale deeds & encumbrance searches
news.para: The land tenure system in Telangana has deep roots in historical land distribution inequities and laws enacted after Independence. The Telangana Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act of 1950 establishes tenant rights, which can complicate current ownership claims. Protected tenants hold significant rights, including the right of first offer for purchase.

news.title: Private equity investment in Indian real estate rises 16% to $4.5 billion in Jan-Sep 2026
news.para: Private equity inflows into Indian real estate increased 16% year-on-year to $4.5 billion during January-September 2026. Q3 inflows stood at $1.3 billion, with hospitality accounting for the largest share of quarterly investments at 26%.

news.title: TGIIC gearing up for fresh land auction in Raidurg
news.para: Next week, the Telangana State Industrial Infrastructure Corporation plans an exciting land auction in Raidurg, presenting two parcels of land spanning six to seven acres each. A senior TGIIC official revealed that the reserve price will likely be around Rs 200 crore per acre, with the auction scheduled strategically before Diwali to entice potential buyers and boost overall auction values.

news.title: Builders in West Bengal must have doctor, ambulance on construction sites with over 200 labourers
news.para: West Bengal's labour department has decreed that construction sites staffed by more than 200 workers must ensure the presence of a doctor at all times. Furthermore, an ambulance should be available to handle emergencies. Labour minister Arjun Singh recently convened with representatives from CREDAI to discuss these crucial measures. To uphold compliance, surprise inspections will be carried out, and any violations will face legal repercussions.

news.title: CM to launch four housing projects by Rajasthan housing board on October 17
news.para: Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma is poised to unveil four innovative projects by the Rajasthan Housing Board across Jaipur, Kishangarh, and Bhiwadi. A standout feature is the Special Registration Scheme catering specifically to accredited journalists in Indira Gandhi Nagar, Jaipur, offering tailored flats to fulfill their housing needs. Additionally, the second phase of Greenwood Horizon in Pratap Nagar will be introduced.

news.title: India ceramic tile exports fall 46% by volume in Apr-Jul 2026; FY27 outlook weak: Report
news.para: India’s ceramic tile exports fell 46% year-on-year by volume to 100 million sq metre during April-July 2026, while export value declined 34% to about ₹4,200 crore. Equirus expects FY27 exports to remain under pressure due to higher freight and energy costs, trade restrictions and disruption at the Morbi manufacturing cluster.

news.title: Delhi development body carries out land pooling policy campaign
news.para: Launching an extensive month-long campaign, the Delhi Development Authority is promoting its Land Pooling Policy. Covering an area of 200 square kilometers, this policy aims to facilitate approximately 12 lakh new housing solutions. Engaging local landowners and farmers through various village gatherings, the focus will be on explaining development methods.

news.title: Delhi: 99% of fire incidents in buildings without valid certificates; LG calls for integrated CCC
news.para: Delhi LG Taranjit Singh Sandhu emphasized the urgent need for a unified command control center to improve fire safety measures. He pointed out that many fires occur in unauthorized areas that lack proper safety certifications. The strategy involves modernizing fire service vehicles and establishing additional fire stations in vulnerable regions.

news.title: Omaxe to invest ₹4,000 crore in 10 hotel projects operated by Lemon Tree Hotels
news.para: Omaxe has signed an MoU with Carnation Hotels, a wholly owned subsidiary of Lemon Tree Hotels, to operate 10 hotel projects comprising 4,000 keys across eight cities. The projects entail an estimated investment of about ₹4,000 crore and form part of Omaxe’s ₹6,200 crore hospitality expansion plan.
